title: My Game Appeared on Some Weird Russian Game Blog? "mmo13"
author: Zamaxan1
selftext:
I was curious and used google lens on my thumbnail for my game, Black Hollow. It appeared as you would expect on the few places I had posted it. (Itch.io - SteamDB - Etc...) But then I noticed some "mmo13" website that was in Russian. 

I clicked on it and it was basically just like a generic page

It just really struck me as odd, I have virtually zero traction right now but have 50 views on Steam from THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION haha. Almost as much as what I have from all the other countries combined (other than the US).

Was curious if anyone knows what exactly this site is/does! Thank you!

comments.author: HLCYSWAP
comments.body: Это ничто. Не обращайте внимания на MMO13.
